en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing a steam locomotive with a long freight train traveling along a river at the base of a steep, rocky hillside. Numerous people stand on the trackside near the locomotive. Coniferous trees cover the distant hills. Text in Russian and Latin script appears at the top, identifying the location as Achinsk and describing the rail route near Mount Kemchug.
